opening.argument: The video promotes instant or recurring Paytm earnings, including ₹10 cashback and a stated ₹5,000 daily income, while directing viewers through a Telegram-posted external link and requiring a Paytm number. It then combines personal and household questions, password creation, verification-code submission, and device “Usage access” with the advertised reward. The speaker specifically instructs viewers, “And you have to copy the verification code on your number. And you have to paste it here. So you have to put the code here and submit it to you.” Displayed cashback and wallet screens provide contextual support for the claimed reward, but they do not establish who operates the link, that the receipts are authentic, that access was granted, or that payment resulted from the described steps. The low-barrier reward offer therefore remains an unverified solicitation involving sensitive information and device access.
